en.title: 'Anna' Rating 4.4%: Why Suzy's Lee Yu-mi Became Anna
en.summary: 'Anna,' broadcast on MBC on August 30, 2026, recorded a nationwide household rating of 4.4% according to Nielsen Korea. It ranked 11th among terrestrial programs that day, with an estimated audience of 838,000 viewers. This figure reflects the show's overall broadcast performance, not the actor's individual standing, and the survey date was August 30.…
